judged_text: `stylesheet_link_tag 'embed'` references a bundle that is never registered for precompilation — the diff adds app/assets/stylesheets/embed.css.scss and app/assets/javascripts/embed.js but adds no 'embed' entry to any asset precompile list. In production, where assets are precompiled and digested, every /embed/best request (both the topic view and the loading view render this layout) raises AssetNotPrecompiledError ("embed.css isn't precompiled") and returns a 500, and embedding sites cannot fetch embed.js either; it appears to work only in development where Sprockets compiles on demand.

Within the diff there is no corresponding change to any asset manifest (e.g. requiring `embed` from `application.css/js`) or to an assets precompile list/initializer, so in a typical Rails/Sprockets production setup this would lead to missing precompiled `embed.css` (and likely `embed.js` if referenced externally) and an `AssetNotPrecompiledError` at runtime.
